shortDescription: Manages isis process id configuration on HUAWEI CloudEngine devices.

options.name: instance_id
options.description: Specifies the id of a isis process.The value is a number of 1 to 4294967295.

options.name: state
options.description: Determines whether the config should be present or not on the device.

options.name: vpn_name
options.description: VPN Instance, associate the VPN instance with the corresponding IS-IS process.
